sources.description: According to The Denver Post’s Luca Evans, New York Jets running back Breece Hall is expected to have serious interest in the Denver Broncos if he becomes a free agent. The problem? The Jets plan on Franchise or Transition tagging Hall if they cannot sign him to an extension and will hold him hostage for […]
